message: I wish I could say thanks to PC for his response, but the fact remains I should not get information on my account from a blog. T-Netix has a responsibility to provide this information to me directly. Period. Not to mention that I should have a right to select the company that I will pay for services rendered. I have Comcast and this whole sad affair went from Comcast to SBC to "T-Hellish". I don't have a say in it and that is supposed to be against the law. The fact that I pay $3.30 to accept and $0.12 a minute for a local call is nothing but insane. Then I have to pay $3.99 each time I replenish the account. Nevermind the number of times calls are just plain dropped. Try as you might there is no way to defend this type of service. If I received this type of service from any other company I could simply switch, now couldn't I... So why should I be forced into dealing with this company because they've made a deal with the corrections facilities and government? This site and many more like it is the American process at it's finest. Your issue isn't with Mike. It's like they say, "don't hate the playa, hate the game".
